items.q: I played with them was on a radio show in Nairobi, that was when with Herb Mann

ctx.x: Marimbas, and that's all they played, they had their own music, that we couldn't of played with them. The only place we played a little with them was on -- I played with them was on a radio show in Nairobi, that was when with Herb Mann, I have a recording of that.
